archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) + Organic warmth for education

fonts.usage: Headings, numbers, distinct labels, dashboards metrics
Body, Data tables, general UI, Indonesian context readability

layout.spacing: Generous internally (p-6, p-8) for dashboard overview cards, compact in data tables (p-3, p-4)
layout.borderRadius: rounded-xl for cards, rounded-full for badges, rounded-lg for buttons

structure.sidebar: w-64 fixed inset-y-0 left-0 z-50 bg-[#0F172A] flex flex-col
structure.topbar: h-16 bg-white border-b border-slate-200 flex items-center justify-between px-6 sticky top-0 z-40

components.cards: bg-white border border-slate-200 shadow-sm rounded-xl hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-200
components.tables: w-full text-left border-collapse. th: font-outfit font-medium text-slate-500 bg-slate-50/50 py-3 px-4 text-xs uppercase tracking-wider. td: border-b border-slate-100 py-3 px-4 font-jakarta text-sm
components.badges: inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium font-outfit
components.buttons: inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-lg font-medium transition-all duration-200 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 disabled:opacity-50 disabled:pointer-events-none hover:-translate-y-0.5 active:translate-y-0 shadow-sm
components.inputs: flex h-10 w-full rounded-md border border-slate-300 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm placeholder:text-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500/20 focus:border-blue-500 transition-colors

images.description: Indonesian students learning, use for login split screen background
Modern building architecture, use for decorative elements or parent dashboard headers

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly use the defined fonts: Outfit for Headings/Metrics, Plus Jakarta Sans for body text. Do not use generic Inter.
Implement the dark sidebar (#0F172A) with light content area (#FAFAFA). The sidebar must feel deeply anchored.
Use role-based color coding exactly as defined (Blue, Emerald, Amber, Purple) for badges, avatars, and dashboard accents to immediately distinguish context.
Data tables must be dense but highly legible. Use Archetype 4 principles: 1px border-slate-100, hover backgrounds on rows (hover:bg-slate-50).
Ensure the login screen has a bilingual EN/ID toggle and utilizes the provided hero_login image on a 50/50 split layout. Place an overlay (bg-slate-900/30) over the image.
All interactive elements MUST have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case for testing.
Avoid generic Shadcn 'card' looks by customizing the border radius to rounded-xl and using the specific shadow-sm.
